exact_source_lines.text: Ðā hē ðā sume dæge hwæthwugu swilces ūte dyde,
and his gefēran tō byrig tō ciricean ēodon, swā hīe gelōm-
lice dydon, and se bisceop, āna in ðǣre ciricean, oððe in
bēcrǣdinge oððe in gebedum geornfull wæs, ðā gehīerde
hē sęmninga, swā-swā hē ęft æfter ðon sægde, ðā swēt-
estan stefne and ðā fægerestan, singendra and blis-
siendra, of heofonum oð eorðan āstīgan. Ðā stefne and
ðone sang hē cwæð ðæt hē ǣrest gehīerde fram ēast-
sūðdǣle heofones, ðæt is fram hēanesse ðǣre winterlican
sunnan ūpganges; and ðanan tō him styccemǣlum nēa-
lǣcton, oð-ðæt hē becōm tō ðæcean ðǣre ciricean ðe se
bisceop in wæs; and, ingangende, eall gefylde, and in
ymbhwyrfte ymbsealde. And hē ðā geornlice his mōd
āðęnede in ðā ðing ðe hē gehīerde. Ðā gehīerde hē
ęft swā-swā healfre tīde fæce, of hrōfe ðǣre ilcan
ciricean ūpāstīgan ðone ilcan blissesang, and, ðȳ ilcan
wege ðe hē ǣr cōm, ūp oð heofonas mid unasęcgendre
swētnesse ęfthweorfan.
Ðā wunode hē ðǣr sum fæc tīde, wundriende and
wafiende; and mid behygdigum mōde ðōhte and smēade
hwæt ðā ðing bēon sceolden. Ðā ontȳnde se bisceop ðæt
ēagðȳrel ðǣre ciricean, and mid his handa slōg tācen,
swā-swā his gewuna wæs gif hwilc mann ūte wǣre, ðæt
hē in tō him ēode. Ðā ēode hē sōna in tō him. Cwæð
hē, se bisceop, him tō: “Gang hraðe tō ciricean, and
hāt ūre seofon brōðor hider tō mē cuman; and ðū ēac
swilce mid wes.”

Ðā stefne and ðone sang hē cwæð ðæt hē ǣrest gehīerde fram ēastsūðdǣle heofones, ðæt is fram hēanesse ðǣre winterlican sunnan ūpganges; and ðanan tō him styccemǣlum nēalǣcton, oð-ðæt hē becōm tō ðæcean ðǣre ciricean ðe se bisceop in wæs; and, ingangende, eall gefylde, and in ymbhwyrfte ymbsealde. And hē ðā geornlice his mōd āðęnede in ðā ðing ðe hē gehīerde. Ðā gehīerde hē ęft swā-swā healfre tīde fæce, of hrōfe ðǣre ilcan ciricean ūpāstīgan ðone ilcan blissesang, and, ðȳ ilcan wege ðe hē ǣr cōm, ūp oð heofonas mid unasęcgendre swētnesse ęfthweorfan. Ðā wunode hē ðǣr sum fæc tīde, wundriende and wafiende; and mid behygdigum mōde ðōhte and smēade hwæt ðā ðing bēon sceolden. Ðā ontȳnde se bisceop ðæt ēagðȳrel ðǣre ciricean, and mid his handa slōg tācen, swā-swā his gewuna wæs gif hwilc mann ūte wǣre, ðæt hē in tō him ēode. Ðā ēode hē sōna in tō him. Cwæð hē, se bisceop, him tō: “Gang hraðe tō ciricean, and hāt ūre seofon brōðor hider tō mē cuman; and ðū ēac swilce mid wes.”

context_only: Owini had left a court household to live and work at Chad’s monastery. While the other brothers studied inside, he did needed work outside. Chad was alone in the local oratory; the companions had gone to the community church. This English orientation is new teaching material, based on the immediately preceding Cook150–152.2 and original note152.5.
unassigned_continuation: The bishop’s exhortation, declaration of his approaching death, later conversation and death follow after153.9. They were inspected to choose the boundary and are not assigned by this span.
